# Cohort script for CLIF project testing temperature trajectories after CAR-T

# Assign temperature trajectory subphenotypes for CAR-T patients
# Requires: data_list (from 00_setup), cohort, temp (from 01_cohort.R)

#Temp Traj Assignment--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
standardize <- function(x) {(x - fmean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / fsd(x, na.rm = TRUE)}
  
temp_index <- data_list$vitals %>%
  dplyr::filter(vital_category == "temp_c") %>%
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, temp_c = vital_value) %>%
  collect() %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    cohort %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, hospitalization_id, cart_t0, temp_pass),
    by = "hospitalization_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    temp_pass == TRUE,
    !is.na(temp_c),
    temp_c >= 30, temp_c < 45,
    !is.na(recorded_dttm),
    recorded_dttm >= cart_t0,
    recorded_dttm <= cart_t0 + lubridate::hours(72)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(patient_id, hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm)

temp_hourly <- temp_index %>%
  dplyr::rename(temp_time = recorded_dttm) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient_id, hospitalization_id, cart_t0) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(t0 = dplyr::first(cart_t0)) %>%
  tidyr::complete(temp_time = seq.POSIXt(from = t0[1], to = t0[1] + lubridate::hours(72), by = "1 hour")) %>%
  tidyr::fill(temp_c, .direction = "down") %>%
  tidyr::fill(temp_c, .direction = "up") %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    temp_hr_post_cart = as.integer(difftime(temp_time, cart_t0, units = "hours")),
    temp_z            = standardize(temp_c)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(patient_id, hospitalization_id, temp_time) %>%
  dplyr::select(patient_id, temp_hr_post_cart, temp_z, temp_c)

temp_model <- temp_hourly %>%
  mutate(
    traj1  = -0.89548 - 0.00298 * temp_hr_post_cart + 0.00010 * (temp_hr_post_cart^2),
    traj2  = -0.00667 + 0.00050 * temp_hr_post_cart - 0.00001 * (temp_hr_post_cart^2),
    traj3  =  1.35157 - 0.06946 * temp_hr_post_cart + 0.00065 * (temp_hr_post_cart^2),
    traj4  =  1.22203 - 0.00590 * temp_hr_post_cart - 0.00007 * (temp_hr_post_cart^2),
    error1 = (temp_z - traj1)^2,
    error2 = (temp_z - traj2)^2,
    error3 = (temp_z - traj3)^2,
    error4 = (temp_z - traj4)^2
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    sum1 = sum(error1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum2 = sum(error2, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum3 = sum(error3, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum4 = sum(error4, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(patient_id)       
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lowest = pmin(sum1, sum2, sum3, sum4),
    model  = case_when(
      lowest == sum1 ~ 4L,
      lowest == sum2 ~ 3L,
      lowest == sum3 ~ 2L,
      lowest == sum4 ~ 1L,
      TRUE           ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
  trajectory = dplyr::case_when(
      model == 1L ~ "HSR",  
      model == 2L ~ "HFR",  
      model == 3L ~ "NT",   
      model == 4L ~ "HT",   
      TRUE        ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, model, trajectory)

#Flag if less than n<5 patients in a trajectory-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (any(table(temp_model$trajectory) <= 5 & table(temp_model$trajectory) > 0)) {
  small_n <- table(temp_model$trajectory)[table(temp_model$trajectory) <= 5 &
                                          table(temp_model$trajectory) > 0]
  stop(paste0(
    "NOTICE: Trajectories with n ≤ 5 detected:\n",
    paste(names(small_n), small_n, sep = " = ", collapse = "\n")
  ), call. = FALSE)
}

#Temperature mean/SD by hour × trajectory ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

temp_hourly_summary <- temp_hourly %>%
  dplyr::left_join(temp_model, by = "patient_id") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(trajectory, temp_hr_post_cart) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_temp = mean(temp_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_temp   = sd(temp_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_patients = dplyr::n_distinct(patient_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
  
#Temperature and other vital sign summaries for entire 72 hour period-------------------------------------------------------  
vitals_72h <- data_list$vitals %>%
  dplyr::filter(vital_category %in% c("temp_c","heart_rate","respiratory_rate","map","spo2")) %>%
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, vital_category, vital_value) %>%
  collect() |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    cohort %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, hospitalization_id, cart_t0, temp_pass),
    by = "hospitalization_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    temp_pass == TRUE,
    recorded_dttm >= cart_t0,
    recorded_dttm <= cart_t0 + lubridate::hours(72)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    hr_post_cart   = as.numeric(difftime(recorded_dttm, cart_t0, units = "hours")),
    vital_category = tolower(vital_category),
    vital_value    = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vital_value))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(temp_model, by = "patient_id") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(trajectory))

vitals_72h_summary <- vitals_72h %>%
  dplyr::group_by(trajectory, vital_category) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_vital = mean(vital_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_vital   = sd(vital_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_patients = dplyr::n_distinct(patient_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Export summaries-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
temp_hourly_summary_path <- file.path(
  project_location, "proj_output",
  paste0("temp_hourly_summary_", today, ".csv")
)

vitals_72h_summary_path <- file.path(
  project_location, "proj_output",
  paste0("vitals_72h_summary_", today, ".csv")
)

data.table::fwrite(temp_hourly_summary, temp_hourly_summary_path)
data.table::fwrite(vitals_72h_summary, vitals_72h_summary_path)



cohort <- cohort %>% dplyr::left_join(temp_model, by = "patient_id")
